emails.subject: Sept 12 reception — need your final music program
emails.body: Hi! Locking my prep for your Sept 12 reception. Please send one final cue sheet before Sept 5: the first dance track, the dinner set in play order with its total run time, and the send-off song. I cue everything off exact track lengths, so run times matter. — Rosalind

emails.subject: Dinner set picks — final
emails.body: Love — these are my final three for dinner, in play order, no more changes I promise: 1. Moonlit Sighs, 2. Mystic Rhythms, 3. Shadow Dance. Slot them between the first dance and the send-off. — P
